findings.statement: Parent order P-AAPL-1400 (BUY 60,000 AAPL via VWAP) executed 52,124 shares across 215 fills on 5 venues.
Implementation shortfall was -17.1 bps versus arrival 229.7800 (decreased by 6.7 bps relative to the baseline's -10.4 bps).
Execution VWAP 229.4973 versus interval VWAP 229.4632: slippage +1.5 bps (baseline +0.4 bps, delta +1.1 bps).
Fill rate was 86.9% of the parent quantity with participation of 5.4% of market volume.
The parent order breached trading limits: max_position (561029.00 vs 500000.00).
Execution quality did not materially deteriorate: arrival shortfall -15.1 bps against a pre-trade estimate of +3.3 bps, a residual of -18.4 bps (-1.00 standard errors; SE 18.5 bps).
Observed participation 5.4% was within the configured VWAP ceiling of 20% (target 8.0%) - behaviour consistent with the strategy configuration and runbook.
Execution latency remained within the normal range (1.01x baseline, p99 996 us).
Realised volatility (3.29 bps/min) was in line with the baseline (1.18x).
Average quoted spread (1.85 bps) was in line with the baseline (1.00x).
Displayed liquidity was normal (97% of baseline depth).
No deployments to the execution path occurred in the hour before or during the window.
No ERROR-level log events were recorded in the window.
No candidate cause scored as material; the window is statistically consistent with the baseline.
Market-data feed quality was normal (no stale runs or crossed quotes of note).
No venue was materially worse than its peers on fill rate or slippage.
Implementation shortfall by component: delay -2.0 bps, spread +0.4 bps, timing -11.1 bps, opportunity -4.5 bps, fees +0.1 bps (total -17.1 bps).
Against the pre-trade estimate of +3.3 bps (fitted square-root model) the arrival shortfall -15.1 bps is a residual of -18.4 bps, -1.22 standard errors (SE 15.2 bps).
Size-weighted effective spread +2.3 bps on aggressive fills, realised spread +8.0 bps at 5 min; markouts 1 s -0.5 bps, 60 s -1.0 bps, 5 min -3.4 bps (positive = price moved our way).
Post-window gross exposure in AAPL was 114,730,631 USD (76% of the notional limit).
